page_title: MON 4-0 AUG | B. Monchengladbach v Augsburg 11/01/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' That's it for today, Harm Osmers has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+4' Ismael Gharbi (Augsburg) produces a shot from a direct free kick on the edge of the box. His effort sails narrowly over the crossbar. The goalkeeper was lucky there.
90+3' Yannik Engelhardt (B. Monchengladbach) trips an opposition player and Harm Osmers signals a foul. Augsburg have a free kick from a promising distance.
90+3' The actual number of corner kicks in this match – 2:2.
90' 3 additional min. will be played.
89' It should have been a goal! Samuel Essende (Augsburg) fires a rocket of a shot but it only hits the crossbar!
85' Here is a change. Joe Scally is going off and Eugen Polanski gives the last tactical orders to Giovanni Reyna (B. Monchengladbach).
85' A substitution has been made. Alexis Claude-Maurice is replaced by Michael Gregoritsch (Augsburg).
84' Luca Netz (B. Monchengladbach) sends a pass into the penalty area, but the opponent manages to cut it out.
82' Joe Scally (B. Monchengladbach) gets on the end of a pass and takes a low shot from the edge of the box which is straight at Finn Dahmen, who makes a comfortable save.
80' Marius Wolf (Augsburg) does well on the edge of the box to find space and powers a shot in on goal that just goes over the bar.
78' Marius Wolf (Augsburg) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
73' Rocco Reitz (B. Monchengladbach) runs into space on the edge of the box and tries a curler that drifts well wide of the left post.
72' Eugen Polanski prepares a substitution. Philipp Sander is replaced by Kota Takai (B. Monchengladbach).
72' Here comes a substitution. Florian Neuhaus is given a rest as he is replaced by Jens Castrop (B. Monchengladbach).
72' Eugen Polanski has decided to substitute Haris Tabakovic and he is replaced by Shuto Machino (B. Monchengladbach).
71' Lovely run from Haris Tabakovic (B. Monchengladbach). He finds himself one-on-one with the goalkeeper, lines up a shot, but the keeper boldly launches himself to intercept the ball.
69' Substitution. Kristijan Jakic (Augsburg) in, Mert Komur out.
68' Rocco Reitz (B. Monchengladbach) takes a quick throw-in so that his teammates can outnumber the defenders in the penalty box.
67' 9:13 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams. The shots on goal statistics – 5:2.
65' Yannik Engelhardt (B. Monchengladbach) finds space inside the box to shoot after collecting a short pass, but it's a wasted effort as it flies high over the bar.
62' It's time for a substitution. Marius Wolf (Augsburg) comes on in place of Mads Pedersen.
62' Manuel Baum has decided to make a change. Ismael Gharbi (Augsburg) replaces Anton Kade.
62' The substitution is prepared. Wael Mohya (B. Monchengladbach) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Franck Honorat.
61' 4 - 0 Goal! Franck Honorat is the provider and Haris Tabakovic (B. Monchengladbach) is the executioner, dispatching the cross into the top left corner from close in with his head. 4:0.
57' Mert Komur floats the corner into the six-yard box, but the ball spins off the head of Cedric Zesiger (Augsburg) and falls to safety well wide of the left post.
57' Mert Komur (Augsburg) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.

57' Mads Pedersen (Augsburg) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence. Augsburg force a corner. They send men into the box.
56' Mert Komur (Augsburg) floats the free kick into the box, but it's easily cleared by the first man.
55' Joe Scally (B. Monchengladbach) knocks his opponent down with an over-the-top tackle. Augsburg will take a free kick near the side line.
54' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Han-Noah Massengo (Augsburg) was quite harsh and Harm Osmers didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
53' Han-Noah Massengo (Augsburg) collects a pass, sees the keeper off his line and shoots from long range, but the effort is disappointing and goes high over the bar.
51' Han-Noah Massengo (Augsburg) serves up a nice cross, but Moritz Nicolas punches the ball away.
50' Yannik Engelhardt (B. Monchengladbach) leans back and sends a volley soaring over the bar from inside the box.

48' Anton Kade (Augsburg) is first to the rebound but his shot is blocked. Wow, what an escape there for the opposition. Robin Fellhauer (Augsburg) collects a rebound a long way out and doesn't hesitate to release a goal-bound hammer of a shot. His attempt is precise and towards the middle of the target. It would have ended in the back of the net if it wasn't for Moritz Nicolas and his nice save.
48' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Samuel Essende (Augsburg) heads on.
46' Manuel Baum makes a switch. Samuel Essende is coming on in place of Fabian Rieder (Augsburg) at the start of the second period.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+4' The end of the first half.

45+2' Keven Schlotterbeck plays the ball through an opponents legs to Alexis Claude-Maurice (Augsburg), who shoots from the edge of the box. The keeper scrambles across his line but the shot rises just over the bar.
45+1' A long cross from the side is directed to the well-positioned Haris Tabakovic (B. Monchengladbach), but the defence gets it clear.
45' There will be a minimum of 3 min. of added time.
42' Rocco Reitz (B. Monchengladbach) whips the ball in from the long-range free kick, but the first man gets it clear.

41' Mads Pedersen (Augsburg) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Harm Osmers blows his whistle for an infringement. A free kick has been awarded to B. Monchengladbach.
41' Mads Pedersen (Augsburg) commits a foul after unfairly battling his opponent for the ball.
38' No foul! Referee Harm Osmers points to the centre spot to indicate that the goal stands after the VAR review. That prompts big celebrations from the B. Monchengladbach players.
37' The B. Monchengladbach players halt their celebrations as referee Harm Osmers makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was a foul in the build-up play.

36' 3 - 0 Goal! Haris Tabakovic (B. Monchengladbach) jumps highest inside the box to meet the resulting corner from Luca Netz. His well-placed header ends up in the top of the net, leaving the goalkeeper flapping in the wind. 3:0.
36' Luca Netz (B. Monchengladbach) is about to take a corner kick.

36' Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach) attempts to find one of his teammates with a sweet pass into the box, but one of the defending players reacts well and intercepts the effort. B. Monchengladbach have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
35' Kevin Diks (B. Monchengladbach) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
33' Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach) sprays a pass out to Haris Tabakovic, but he can't beat his man to get to the ball.
31' The total number of attempts is 4:7. The up-to-date shots on target statistics – 3:1.
30' Cedric Zesiger (Augsburg) tries his luck with a shot from long distance after receiving a good pass. His poorly placed effort flies miles wide of the right post.
29' Alexis Claude-Maurice (Augsburg) sees an unmarked teammate and attempts to send him a low pass. However, one of the defenders reads the game perfectly and averts the danger.
27' Great teamplay by Augsburg as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
26' Anton Kade (Augsburg) attempts to score with a first-time shot from the edge of the box. His low effort towards the middle of the goal is saved by Moritz Nicolas.
24' Anton Kade sprays a pass out to Alexis Claude-Maurice (Augsburg), but he produces a poor effort from inside the box which goes well wide of the left post.
20' 2 - 0 Goal! Kevin Diks (B. Monchengladbach) puts the ball into the left side of the goal past the outstretched arm of Finn Dahmen.
20' Kevin Diks (B. Monchengladbach) is going to take the penalty!
20' Referee Harm Osmers is happy with his original decision after the VAR review. It’s a PENALTY to B. Monchengladbach!
19' There's some confusion. Looks like the ref is going to review the penalty decision to B. Monchengladbach using VAR. Let's see what happens.
19' The ball spins up and hits the hand of Mads Pedersen (Augsburg) after he fails to control it and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. B. Monchengladbach are about to take a penalty!
18' 64:36 – the latest ball possession ratio.
18' Mert Komur (Augsburg) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
16' Anton Kade (Augsburg) gets on the end of the resulting free kick, but he produces a poor shot which goes well wide of the right post!
15' Referee Harm Osmers sees the trip by Yannik Engelhardt (B. Monchengladbach) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle. That's a free kick to Augsburg.
14' Mads Pedersen (Augsburg) fizzes over a cross which doesn't cause any problems. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for B. Monchengladbach.
14' Moritz Nicolas leaps to collect the ball from the corner which was sent over by Mert Komur (Augsburg).
13' Mads Pedersen (Augsburg) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. The referee signals a corner kick to Augsburg.
10' The resulting corner from Luca Netz (B. Monchengladbach) is cleared.
10' Florian Neuhaus (B. Monchengladbach) gets on the end of a pass on the edge of the box but his shot is blocked. It will be a corner kick for B. Monchengladbach.
8' 1 - 0 Goal! A rebound wrong foots everyone except Joe Scally (B. Monchengladbach), and he slams the ball into the open net from close range. 1:0.
8' Joe Scally (B. Monchengladbach) connects with an accurate pass inside the box and fires the ball to the bottom right corner, but one of the defending players steps in to block the effort.
6' Fabian Rieder (Augsburg) strikes from the edge of the box, but hits it really poorly and sends the ball way wide of the right post.
5' Florian Neuhaus (B. Monchengladbach) slips through the defence and passes the ball in from the edge of the box. Haris Tabakovic picks it up but loses it to one of the defenders.
3' B. Monchengladbach control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
1' Rocco Reitz (B. Monchengladbach) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
The players are on the pitch and B. Monchengladbach will have the kick-off.
Harm Osmers is introduced as the referee for today's match.
